name: http_api.list_records
description: List records of an entity through the governed http_api/CRM connection

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity to list (e.g. leads); defaults to the bound entity

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Query-style filters applied within the governed connection

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return

name: http_api.get_record
description: Read a single record through the governed http_api/CRM connection

parameters.name: entity
parameters.description: Entity the record belongs to (e.g. leads)

parameters.name: record_id
parameters.description: Record identifier within the governed connection
